principle: Implemented or configured does not mean publicly available.

claims.claim: OpFin is a connected financial-wellbeing and access platform built for Uganda.
claims.notes: Positioning claim. Avoid implying that every financial product family is already live.

claims.claim: New customers start phone-first in the OpFin App using OTP, names and a six-digit PIN.
One identity can participate in multiple authorised Financial Spaces without automatically sharing Personal Space information.
claims.notes: Authority and privacy separation remains subject to accepted release verification.

claims.claim: Responsible finance should present affordability, costs, repayment obligations, disclosures and understandable decision information before acceptance.
claims.notes: Describe as platform direction/control principle rather than a blanket live-provider promise.

claims.claim: Savings, investment and protection journeys may be available through approved partners.
claims.notes: Always retain partner/eligibility/activation qualification. Do not list a provider or product as live without activation evidence.

claims.claim: Islamic finance, social finance, digital capital extensions and other future-gated product families are live.
claims.notes: Do not publish as live until the applicable legal, governance, finance, security, provider and production gates are complete.
